messages.subject: Summer Stats Camp
parts:
As we are heading for summer, we have a new edition of the Stats Camp in person session at the beginning of June. The in person session is on Albuquerque, New Mexico, but there are also several courses onlie during the year

Please check the offered courses, several of them use lavaan and other R packages, like the SEM foundations, and Longitudinal SEM ones

I will be teaching a Bayesian Data analysis using brms R package as well

https://www.statscamp.org/

Hope to see some of you there

-- Mauricio GV
